WITH l AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts_multi_store', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts_multi_date', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999_lines', count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900_nonweb_chan', count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id=900 AND channel_id=1
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_chan_nonweb_store', count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id<>900 AND channel_id IN (2,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', count(*) FROM l WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_in_web', count(*) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag AND channel_id IN (2,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'loaded_distinct', count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'line_in_stg', count(*) FROM l WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM stg_sales_line_load)
UNION ALL SELECT 'net_gross_mismatch', count(*) FROM l WHERE abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02

WITH w AS (SELECT receipt_id, channel_id, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT o.status, w.channel_id, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) orders, sum(w.net) net, sum(abs(w.gross-o.order_total_gross)>0.02) gross_mismatch, sum(w.n<>o.line_count) linecount_mismatch
FROM w JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=w.receipt_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement: SELECT date_trunc('week', sale_date) wk, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, sum(net_amount) net, min(etl_loaded_at) l0, max(etl_loaded_at) l1 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-27' AND DATE '2026-08-09' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (NOT d.is_trading_day OR d.is_public_holiday OR d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-12' AND DATE '2026-06-23')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.channel_id, s.store_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT 'all_ex_training_incl_staff' v, sum(net)/count(*) atv, count(*) n, sum(net) net FROM r WHERE store_id<>999
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_ex_training_ex_staff', sum(net)/count(*), count(*), sum(net) FROM r WHERE store_id<>999 AND NOT staff
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_incl_training_incl_staff', sum(net)/count(*), count(*), sum(net) FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_only_ex_staff', sum(net)/count(*), count(*), sum(net) FROM r WHERE store_id<900 AND NOT staff
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_only', sum(net)/count(*), count(*), sum(net) FROM r WHERE store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'training', sum(net)/count(*), count(*), sum(net) FROM r WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_only', sum(net)/count(*), count(*), sum(net) FROM r WHERE staff
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_ex_training_ex_staff', sum(gross)/count(*), count(*), sum(gross) FROM r WHERE store_id<>999 AND NOT staff

WITH receipt AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.channel_id, s.store_id, d.fiscal_year,
         bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS has_staff_line, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.channel_id, s.store_id, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT fiscal_year, round(sum(receipt_net) / count(*), 2) AS atv_eur_excl_vat
FROM receipt
WHERE store_id <> 999 AND NOT has_staff_line
GROUP BY fiscal_year
